meta.title: Akra | Custom Furniture Made to Order, Shipped Worldwide
meta.description: Furniture crafted to your design, materials, and finish. From a single piece to full containers, shipped worldwide for importers, designers, and homes.
meta.ogImageAlt: Handcrafted wooden furniture by Akra in warm natural light

about.title: Handcrafted furniture that feels timeless
about.intro: Every piece is made to order in the wood, size and finish you choose. We build it by hand in our workshop and ship it to homes and showrooms around the world.
about.story: Akra grew from Jepara, the town the world sources its furniture from. Not handed down, but built by choice — akar karya, roots and craft. Those roots now reach homes and showrooms worldwide.
